items.title: 'Here we go': Alcaraz confirms US Open return after four-month injury layoff
items.summary: “Here we go,” Alcaraz wrote on his social media accounts on Thursday, along with a picture of himself in front of the US Open logo.

items.title: Spurs agree £75m deal to sign Man City's Savinho
items.summary: Tottenham agree a deal to sign Manchester City winger Savinho for £75m, with a further £10m in potential add-ons.

items.title: Bangladesh eye more history with only one result on Australia's mind
